Class OrganizationService

java.lang.Object
project.services.OrganizationService
public class OrganizationService extends Object
Manages student organizations: creation, membership, and join-request handling.

  • Method Details

    • createOrganization

      public void createOrganization(Student student, String name)
      Creates a new organization led by the student. Fails if they already lead one, the name is blank, or the name is already taken.
      Parameters:
      student - the student who will lead the new organization
      name - the desired organization name

    • listOrganizations

      public void listOrganizations()
      Prints all organizations with their lead and member count.

    • joinOrganization

      public void joinOrganization(Student student, String orgId)
      Submits a join request for the student to an organization. Skips if already a member.
      Parameters:
      student - the student who wants to join
      orgId - the organization's ID

    • viewOrgMembers

      public void viewOrgMembers(String userId)
      Prints the members of the organization the user belongs to.
      Parameters:
      userId - the user's ID (must be a member of some organization)

    • listOrgJoinRequests

      public void listOrgJoinRequests(String leadId)
      Lists all pending join requests for the organizations led by the given user.
      Parameters:
      leadId - the organization lead's user ID

    • handleOrgJoinRequest

      public void handleOrgJoinRequest(Student lead, String reqId, boolean accept)
      Approves or rejects an organization join request. Only the organization lead may act on it. Accepted applicants are added as members and notified.
      Parameters:
      lead - the current organization lead
      reqId - the request ID to process
      accept - true to accept, false to reject
